value.rationale: This supplies a complete natural first threshold for failure of joint Tutte-polynomial and degree-multiset determination of rational cohomology among unicyclic graphs. The two distinct nonisomorphic pairs at different girths have exact higher-degree Betti vectors and unequal total Betti ranks, providing a nontrivial reference case beyond newly understood path graphs. No infinite theorem is claimed; the finite classification and precise cohomological separation form the mathematical value.
